item: 9.9 retired + the gauge follows the CLI's window for ANY pick (2026-10-10)
branch: #modelFooter has no #tgl1m (fast + thinking + effort remain); reconcileFromResult matches result.modelUsage by the selection, by what Default resolves to, AND by the selection's roster resolvedModel, ignoring [1m] on both sides (windowFromUsage); windowConfirmed is set by a match and cleared by showModel / __models; a result keyed only by a side model changes nothing; a persisted tagged value ('sonnet[1m]') still selects and still matches.
provenance: MEASURED 2026-10-10 on 2.1.296 over stdio (scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, one turn each): set_model 'sonnet' → init.model claude-sonnet-5-5, result.modelUsage {'claude-sonnet-5-5': {contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-sonnet-5-5'}}; set_model 'sonnet[1m]' → init.model claude-sonnet-5-5[1m], modelUsage keyed 'claude-sonnet-5-5[1m]' with the same window and canonicalModel; the audit measured opus / opus[1m] / sonnet[1m] the same way. The roster items are the real 2.1.296 shape (tagless values, Default resolving to claude-sonnet-5-5 on this account). USER HAND TEST in the real PhpStorm 2026-10-10: with the switch OFF on 'sonnet' the gauge read 20% for ~40K tokens (4% of the real 1M), and the reconcile never corrected it because the lookup compared the alias to the full-id key.

steps.note: 0 — the footer has NO 1M switch: two switch rows (fast, thinking) + the effort row; the roster is the real 2.1.296 shape (tagless), 'sonnet' selected
steps.setup: window.__g97 = JSON.stringify({ items: models, selected: currentModel, used: ctxUsed, win: ctxWindowFromCli }); window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: '__models', selected: 'sonnet', items: [{"value": "default", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Default (recommended)", "description": "Sonnet 5.5 \u00b7 Efficient for routine tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": false}, {"value": "opus", "resolvedModel": "claude-opus-5-5", "displayName": "Opus 5.5", "description": "For complex work and everyday tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": true}, {"value": "fable", "resolvedModel": "claude-fable-5-1", "displayName": "Fable 5.1", "description": "For your toughest challenges", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "sonnet", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Sonnet 5.5", "description": "Most efficient for simpler tasks", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "haiku", "resolvedModel": "claude-haiku-5-5", "displayName": "Haiku 5.5", "description": "Fastest for quick answers"}] })); document.getElementById('modelChip').click();

expect.why: GUARD: the menu is open
the 1M switch is gone (retired 2026-10-10: the CLI serves 1M with or without the tag; the switch only mis-set the gauge)
fast + thinking remain
the effort row remains
GUARD: the Sonnet row is checked

steps.note: 1 — an ALIAS pick ('sonnet') follows the CLI's reported window: the result's modelUsage is keyed by the full id (claude-sonnet-5-5) and the gauge adopts its 1M — 40K tokens read 4%, not the seed's 20%
steps.setup: closeMenus(); setContext(40000); window.__w97a = ctxWindow(); reconcileFromResult({ modelUsage: { 'claude-sonnet-5-5': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', inputTokens: 2 }, 'claude-haiku-5-5': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-haiku-5-5', inputTokens: 1 } } });

expect.why: GUARD: before the result the untagged alias seeds 200K (both builds)
the result's window matched through the roster's resolvedModel (the old lookup compared the alias 'sonnet' to the key and missed — the live panel read 20% after a real turn, 2026-10-10)
the gauge shows the real share
the selection is now CLI-confirmed

steps.note: 2 — the side-model trap: a result keyed ONLY by a side model does not touch the gauge
steps.setup: showModel('opus'); window.__w97b = ctxWindow(); reconcileFromResult({ modelUsage: { 'claude-haiku-5-5': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-haiku-5-5' } } });

expect.why: GUARD: a new pick re-seeds from the (tagless) roster
no match → no update (the seed is a decent guess, a wrong number is not)
nothing confirmed

steps.note: 3 — Default: the result keyed by what Default resolves to matches (effectiveModelId); a tagged key still matches a tagged or untagged selection
steps.setup: window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: '__models', selected: 'default', items: [{"value": "default", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Default (recommended)", "description": "Sonnet 5.5 \u00b7 Efficient for routine tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": false}, {"value": "opus", "resolvedModel": "claude-opus-5-5", "displayName": "Opus 5.5", "description": "For complex work and everyday tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": true}, {"value": "fable", "resolvedModel": "claude-fable-5-1", "displayName": "Fable 5.1", "description": "For your toughest challenges", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "sonnet", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Sonnet 5.5", "description": "Most efficient for simpler tasks", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "haiku", "resolvedModel": "claude-haiku-5-5", "displayName": "Haiku 5.5", "description": "Fastest for quick answers"}] })); reconcileFromResult({ modelUsage: { 'claude-sonnet-5-5[1m]': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' } } }); window.__w97c = ctxWindow(); showModel('sonnet[1m]'); window.__chip97 = document.getElementById('modelChip').title; window.__row97 = (document.querySelector('#modelItems .popup-item.on') || {}).dataset; reconcileFromResult({ modelUsage: { 'claude-sonnet-5-5': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' } } });

expect.why: Default → resolvedModel claude-sonnet-5-5 matches the [1m]-tagged key (tags ignored both sides)
a persisted tagged value is still a valid selection (its exact id on the chip's title)
…and the Sonnet row keeps its ✓ (the ✓ ignores the tag)
a tagged selection matches an untagged key

steps.note: 4 — a roster push resets the confirmation: the new selection re-seeds until its own result speaks
steps.setup: window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: '__models', selected: 'haiku', items: [{"value": "default", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Default (recommended)", "description": "Sonnet 5.5 \u00b7 Efficient for routine tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": false}, {"value": "opus", "resolvedModel": "claude-opus-5-5", "displayName": "Opus 5.5", "description": "For complex work and everyday tasks", "supportsEffort": true, "supportsFastMode": true}, {"value": "fable", "resolvedModel": "claude-fable-5-1", "displayName": "Fable 5.1", "description": "For your toughest challenges", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "sonnet", "resolvedModel": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "displayName": "Sonnet 5.5", "description": "Most efficient for simpler tasks", "supportsEffort": true}, {"value": "haiku", "resolvedModel": "claude-haiku-5-5", "displayName": "Haiku 5.5", "description": "Fastest for quick answers"}] })); window.__w97d = ctxWindow(); window.__c97d = windowConfirmed; reconcileFromResult({ modelUsage: { 'claude-haiku-5-5': { contextWindow: 1000000, canonicalModel: 'claude-haiku-5-5' } } });

expect.why: re-seeded (haiku untagged)
the previous selection's confirmation did not leak
then confirmed by its own result

steps.note: 5 — restore the roster, selection and gauge
